title: Poland’s president vetoes strict crypto bill, clashes with government
summary: Poland’s president has vetoed a sweeping cryptocurrency bill over concerns that it would drive startups abroad, sparking a fierce political clash.

title: X402 ecosystem expands as Solana becomes number-one network for payments
summary: Solana has quietly become the busiest chain for x402 payments, clocking an all-time high $380,000 in daily volume and a 750% weekly jump.

title: Ripple, major VCs back RWA platform OpenEden to scale tokenized Treasurys
summary: OpenEden has raised an undisclosed round backed by Ripple and major institutions to expand tokenized US Treasurys.

title: FDIC acting chair says framework for stablecoin laws coming this month
summary: FDIC acting chair Travis Hill will inform the House Financial Services Committee that the regulator plans to propose how it will apply the GENIUS Act this month.

title: Bitcoin miner Canaan plans adaptive green-energy mining platform
summary: Canaan has been steadily investing in renewable energy projects, with a gas-to-computing pilot in Canada and a deal to deploy miners at a wind-powered data center in Texas.

title: Bollinger Bands suggest Bitcoin bottom won’t fall under $55K
summary: A crypto analyst used Bollinger Bands and RSI data to argue Bitcoin’s bear market bottom will not pass under $55,000.

title: Ethereum ICO wallet moves $120M after a decade, throws it into staking
summary: Fears tend to mount whenever an OG crypto whale starts shifting funds, but this one used it to double down on the blockchain network.

title: BitMine buys $70M ETH while Tom Lee revises Bitcoin prediction
summary: BitMine now holds over $10 billion in Ether, doubling down on its strategy to accumulate 5% of the supply despite being underwater on its total position.

title: Ethereum devs work on ‘Secret Santa’ protocol to power privacy
summary: A Solidity engineer proposed a protocol earlier this year using zero-knowledge proofs and transaction relayers to enable a Secret Santa-like feature on Ethereum.

title: CZ’s YZi Labs moves to take over board of flatlining BNB treasury
summary: YZi Labs has asked CEA Industries shareholders to support its move to shake up the BNB treasury company’s board and install its pick of directors.
